title: Do you go anywhere besides mall world?
content: I go to mall world and have nearly every night in my life. Outside of a few specific circumstances where my dreams were precognizant. I once dreamt my cat fell off my apartment balcony at my then current apartment, one week later he did. I had a dream I watched a bunny bleed out and die, assumed what the symbols (bunny, blood, death)meant and assumed fertility issues. I had a miscarriage a month later. I was being cheated on once, had a dream of a blond and redhead in my ex boyfriends vehicle. Well, you wouldn't believe his 2 girlfriends called me that same week to get me out of his life, a blonde and a redhead. Any dreams that are not in mall world are precognizant in a sense. These are just a couple examples and I may sound absolutely bananas. My mall world is just like what's described here. The forest, the woods, the hotel on the coast. Does anyone else experience precognizant dreams in combination with their mall world? I've verbalized my dreams since I could speak and they've always been like this.
